annotation_method: Initial labels and boxes were manually recorded from original ABEMA images and nearest-neighbour magnified crops before inference. Red fives are separate classes. Human visual review after overlays corrected one normal five-sou label and one too-narrow West tile bounding box; details in annotation_revisions. Predictions were not used as labels.
annotation_revisions: 10059940 GT14 West bounding box initially omitted the oblique left edge; expanded to the full visible face after reviewing the original pixels.

10163230 GT4 originally mislabeled red five-sou: original pixels show one red center bamboo and four green corners, which is normal 5s. Red 0s has all red bamboo. Corrected by visual review, not treated as a model error.
